reason_for_new_version: V2 showed that M28 cannot reproduce the real baseline composition: only 3258 simulated nonrare REF-monomorphic sites are available versus 30283 in the authenticated baseline. V3 stops copying the real marker geometry and uses only its independently measured count of 79791 informative REF-polymorphic markers as an external density anchor.

analysis_interval.rule: Use the exact genomic span of the authenticated baseline, inclusive.
analysis_interval.rationale: All comparator arms must cover the same chromosome interval; the real baseline positions are not used as a spatial template.

marker_definitions.rare_universe: MAC>=2 and MAF<0.01 in FREQ, minor allele oriented from GT, with at least one minor copy in pooled REF_LAI.
marker_definitions.common_universe: MAF>=0.01 in FREQ, with both the FREQ-oriented minor allele and its complement observed in pooled REF_LAI.
marker_definitions.b0: Exactly 79791 common-universe sites selected deterministically and proportionally across genetic-distance bins.
marker_definitions.bs: B0 plus K common-universe reserve sites selected as spatial controls for BR.

allocation.bin_origin: Interpolate cM at the authenticated baseline first_position and use that value as bin zero for every width.
allocation.primary_width_rule: Use the narrowest preregistered width passing all capacity, parity, ancestry and common-common geometry gates.
allocation.b0_quota_rule: Allocate the exact global B0 count proportionally to the common-universe count in each bin by Hamilton largest remainders; rank sites within bin by a fixed SHA-256 salt.
allocation.K_rule: For each bin, K_bin=min(eligible rare count, common reserve count), and K=sum(K_bin). K is therefore derived from spatial capacity rather than chosen from a performance result.
allocation.rare_selection: Within each bin, rank eligible rare sites by fixed SHA-256 and keep exactly K_bin. Do not rank by ancestry, FST, DONOR, TARGET, truth or LAI performance.
allocation.control_matching: Match selected rare sites to unique common-reserve sites within the same cM bin using the same deterministic monotonic nearest rule at every screened width.
allocation.common_common_null: For each width, generate 32 deterministic common pseudo-query samples from B0 with the same K_bin counts and match them to the same common reserve. Gate the observed rare-common p95 absolute delta and Wasserstein distance against the maximum of the 32 null summaries; report one-sided Monte Carlo ranks.

gates.V3_0_INPUT_IDENTITY: All input hashes and baseline known-answer counts match exactly.
gates.V3_1_ACCESS_BOUNDARY: Only FREQ and REF_LAI genotypes enter allocation.
gates.V3_2_SHARED_INTERVAL: Every B0, BR and BS marker lies in the same authenticated interval.
gates.V3_3_B0_ANCHOR: B0 contains exactly 79791 unique common REF-polymorphic simulated sites.
gates.V3_4_ARM_PARITY: BR and BS add exactly K unique markers with identical per-bin counts and no overlap with B0.
gates.V3_5_RARE_SCOPE: Selected rare markers retain nonzero support in AFR, EUR and ASIA; ASIA is never relabelled NAM.
gates.V3_6_GEOMETRY: Rare-common p95 absolute delta and Wasserstein distance do not exceed the maxima from 32 deterministic common-common null replicates.
gates.V3_7_REPRODUCIBILITY: Two independent executions produce byte-identical scientific outputs.
gates.V3_8_SCOPE: No LAI model or truth metric is computed.

stop_rule: Stop before LAI if no preregistered width passes every gate, K is zero, any ancestry loses reference-supported rare evidence, common-common geometry fails, selection needs forbidden pools or performance, or reproducibility fails. Do not change salts, widths, null count or thresholds after inspecting outputs.
